title: Off the Back Rank
setup: Black's rook on f8 holds the f7 pawn and the back rank at once, and your bishop on b3 cuts through f7.
hint: The rook is the only piece guarding the eighth rank. What can you give it that it has to take?
explanation:
## The Idea

{{Qxf7+}} cannot be taken by the king, since the bishop on b3 covers f7, so {{Rxf7}} is forced. The rook is now pinned and off the back rank, and {{Re8#}} ends the game. A rook that has to recapture is a rook that is no longer defending.
